nodes.description: Immutable state variable holding the IERC20 collateral asset used by the locker.
Immutable state variable storing the Loan contract address allowed to pull collateral.
Constructor initializing collateralAsset and loan state variables.
Modifier restricting callers to the loan address; validates msg.sender against loan.
External function that transfers collateral asset to dst, guarded by the isLoan modifier.
Caller address supplied by the transaction, validated against the loan state variable.
External token transfer via SafeERC20.safeTransfer on collateralAsset, an untrusted contract call.
Constructor parameter supplying the collateral asset address.
Constructor parameter supplying the authorized loan address.
Destination address for the collateral transfer in pull.
Amount of collateral asset to transfer in pull.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _collateralAsset is consumed by the constructor to initialize state.
Constructor parameter _loan is consumed by the constructor to initialize state.
Constructor writes the _collateralAsset value into the collateralAsset state variable.
Constructor writes the _loan value into the loan state variable.
Parameter dst flows into the safeTransfer destination inside pull.
Parameter amt flows into the safeTransfer amount inside pull.
pull invokes the safeTransfer external token call with dst and amt.
collateralAsset is the token contract targeted by the external safeTransfer call.
msg.sender is the untrusted input checked by the isLoan modifier against the loan state variable.
loan state variable is compared with msg.sender to enforce the access-control check.
isLoan modifier gates execution of pull, restricting collateral transfers to the loan.
